thread:
elaine (CEO): quick weekly from me 	6 small set of asks and FYIs. top priorities: 1) LATAM Dedicated soft-launch next week, 2) finalize data-retention policy change (logs -> 90d, audits 365d), 3) tighten hosted p99 target to <140ms. details below. :loudspeaker:

devon (VP Eng): noted. runtime will prioritize tail-latency fixes and a KV cache warmup for canary traffic. scheduling a 90m perf sync tuesday.

mia (VP Product): product will run a 48hr canary for LATAM with staged customers only. need infra confirmation on fallback variants and SLA gating. i'll post the canary checklist in #release-war-room by monday noon.

harry (CTO): ops/security: data residency for LATAM will use eu-data-region as stopgap while we finalise the latam-region infra. compliance ok with 90d debug logs if audit logs are preserved at 365d. legal asked for a short memo.

oncall-bot: incident summary 1984119001 : brief control-plane cache eviction caused ~8m elevated latencies for chat endpoints in us-east. mitigation: increased cache TTL, rolled back faulty GC param. RCA links: https://internal.redwood/incident/1984119001

devon (VP Eng): root cause: aggressive GC for kv-cache triggered during heavy prefix churn. small fix merged: ```diff
- gc.setThreshold(0.1)
+ gc.setThreshold(0.25)
```

elaine (CEO): two asks: 1) one-pager RCA into incidents by EOD tomorrow, 2) eng-infra to add a smoke-test that simulates prefix churn in CI.

mia (VP Product): for LATAM fallback variants, recommend `redwood-lite-q8` then `redwood-min-dense`. these balance latency and quality. adding to canary config now.

devon (VP Eng): will wire automatic fallback chain: preferred -> redwood-lite-q8 -> redwood-min-dense -> 503. publishing PR shortly.

finance-bot: budget note: LATAM soft-launch buffer estimate = $45k for month 1 (capacity + egress). provisional hold approved; marketing spend must wait til SLA signoff.

harry (CTO): policy change timeline: draft retention policy v1 published in docs repo. request approvals from security and legal by wednesday COB.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for `dedicated-latam` (build 2025.06.04-21). status: canary in progress.

elaine (CEO): recruiting push: hiring 1 Sr. Kernel Engineer and 1 Senior Infra SWE. referral bonus active; please share candidate names. final note: small disciplined wins on latency and cost beat flashy launches. we'll review p99 metrics in the Friday check-in at 9am PT. thanks team. :rocket:
